sections.title: Eligibility and preparation
sections.text:
Eligibility for your route [Standing rule]
International applicants eligible; mathematics PhD accepts graduate applications, but exact direct-bachelor
prerequisites/GPA threshold require current central review. UChicago degree supports English waiver after
completion. [s1] [s7]
Before submission [Standing rule]
Use general Graduate School application; collect transcripts, at least 2 referees, statement and applicable
supplemental papers/CV; arrange English exemption or testing. [s1] [s2]
Adviser contact [Standing rule]
Research page encourages contacting faculty matching interests before arrival; acceptance of a supervisor
before applying is not stated. [s4]
Portal workflow [Standing rule]
General Graduate School/ApplyWeb. Additional materials before decision can be emailed
gradapp@mailbox.sc.edu with subject Update Application; declined applicants must reapply with all supporting
documentation. [s2] [s3]
Cycle verification [2027 confirmed]
Department explicitly updated for Fall 2027 deadline and funding. [s1]

sections.title: English and GRE
sections.text:
English requirement [Standing rule]
Math page: TOEFL 80 admission/100 teaching assistantship (old scale or concordance equivalent); TOEFL or
IELTS required for non-native speakers unless exempt. Central accepts additional tests; department
acceptance/TA thresholds for alternatives need confirmation. [s1] [s2]

UChicago English exemption [Standing rule]
Mathematics explicitly waives TOEFL after completion of a U.S. or Canadian higher-education degree. This
supports exemption for completed UChicago bachelor’s; in-progress treatment and TA waiver mechanics not
explicit. [s1]
GRE General; GRE Mathematics [Unresolved]
Neither appears on current mathematics basic application checklist; no explicit statement whether optional
scores are considered or prohibited. Confirm portal if submitting. [s1]

sections.title: Funding and fees
sections.text:
Amount and coverage [2027 confirmed]
Fall 2027:10-13 assistantships expected; starting $21,000 annually ($10,500/semester), full tuition abatement.
Summer pay separate/variable. [s1]
Years of support; Conditions and duties [Standing rule]
Renewable up to 5 years subject to annual scholarship/teaching review; assistants teach unless supported by
faculty grants; first-year pedagogical coursework accompanies progression to instructor duties. [s1]

International eligibility [Standing rule]
International TA eligibility explicitly discussed with higher English threshold; no citizenship exclusion stated for
assistantships. Individual fellowships’ eligibility needs confirmation. [s1]
Extra funding application [Unresolved]
Not established by the cited public admissions materials. Confirm in the current application or with graduate
admissions before relying on a rule.
Other funding routes [Standing rule]
Presidential fellowship $12,000/year for 4 years; Arts/Sciences fellowship $4,000/year for 4 years. Historically
summer support for first-year qualifying and many second-year comprehensive exam preparation; later faculty
grants/external employment. Not guaranteed summer funding. [s1]
Application fee [2027 confirmed]
Effective August 1, 2026, fee reinstated: $50 per primary application. [s2]
Fee waiver [Standing rule]
Graduate School does not grant individual application fee-waiver requests. [s2]

sections.title: Potential advisers and recent research
sections.text:
Algebraic geometry
Matthew Ballard
Derived categories, mirror symmetry, birational geometry and invariant theory. [s4] [s5]
Listed on official departmental faculty pages; availability to supervise new PhD students is not published.
Research evidence: 2026 · High Frobenius Pushforwards Generate the Bounded Derived Category
Recent research evidence; verify supervision availability separately.
Algebraic and arithmetic geometry
Alexander Duncan
Birational geometry, Galois cohomology, algebraic groups, rational surfaces and toric varieties. [s4] [s6]
Listed on official departmental faculty pages; availability to supervise new PhD students is not published.
Research evidence: 2025 · Representations of finite subgroups of Cremona groups
Recent research evidence; verify supervision availability separately.

Number theory
Matthew Boylan
Modular/Maass forms, elliptic curves, L-functions and partitions. [s4] [s5]
Listed on official departmental faculty pages; availability to supervise new PhD students is not published.
Research evidence: 2026 · Congruence Properties Modulo Prime Powers for a Class of Partition Functions
Recent research evidence; verify supervision availability separately.
Ognian Trifonov
Analytic and additive number theory, squarefree numbers, primes and covering systems. [a10] [a10p]
Current departmental faculty; accepting new doctoral students is not confirmed publicly.
Research evidence: 2025 · Representing Positive Integers as a Sum of a Squarefree Number and a Small Prime
Recent research evidence; verify supervision availability separately.
Michael Filaseta
Analytic and elementary number theory; polynomial irreducibility, primes, covering systems and Diophantine
problems. [a12] [a12p]
Carolina Trustees Professor Emeritus since 2020, according to his updated CV. Recent doctoral completions are listed, but new
supervision must be confirmed rather than assumed.
Research evidence: 2024 preprint; subsequent publication details should be checked · On the distance between factorials and
repunits
Recent research evidence; verify supervision availability separately.
Number theory / arithmetic geometry
Frank Thorne
Distribution of number fields and class-group torsion, analytic number theory, Shintani zeta functions and
arithmetic statistics. [a8] [a8p]
Current departmental faculty; accepting new doctoral students is not confirmed publicly.
Research evidence: 2025 preprint · Asymptotics for 6-torsion and D6-extensions
Recent research evidence; verify supervision availability separately.
Algebraic geometry / commutative algebra
Andrew Kustin
Commutative algebra and algebraic geometry, Gorenstein algebras, resolutions, linkage and Lefschetz
properties. [b14] [b14p]
Current faculty; accepting new doctoral students is not publicly confirmed.
Research evidence: 2025 · Artinian Gorenstein algebras of socle degree three which have the weak Lefschetz property
Recent research evidence; verify supervision availability separately.
Adela Vraciu
Positive-characteristic commutative algebra, tight closure, Hilbert-Kunz functions and homological properties of
rings and modules. [b16] [b16p]
Current faculty; accepting new doctoral students is not publicly confirmed.
Research evidence: 2023 · The syzygies of the ideal (x_1^N,x_2^N,x_3^N,x_4^N) in the hypersurface ring defined by
x_1^n+x_2^n+x_3^n+x_4^n over any field
Recent research evidence; verify supervision availability separately.
